problem:
Consider the vector $x$ and the subspace $S=\text{Span}{v,w},$ where

$$
v=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 1 \\ 1\end{aligned}],\,w=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -1 \\ -1\end{aligned}],\,\,x=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 3 \\ 0\end{aligned}].
$$

Find the acute angle between $x$ and the subspace $S$ given that the set ${v,w}$ is orthogonal.

activity_context.topic_title: Projecting Vectors Onto Subspaces in Euclidean Spaces (Orthogonal Bases)
